items.title: Designing Clean and Responsive Interfaces (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Designing Clean and Responsive Interfaces (PDF 54, printed 50), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Saaf (clean) interface mein widgets saleeqe se rakhe hote hain aur un ke darmiyan kafi jagah hoti hai. Text aur buttons wazeh aur parhne mein aasan hone chahiye. Responsive interface window ka size badalne par apna layout badal leta hai, is liye program mukhtalif screen sizes par achha chalta hai. Theek alignment (seedh) application ki shakal behtar karta hai, aur saada design interface ko user-friendly banata hai.

items: Saaf interface: tarteeb, kafi jagah, wazeh text.
Responsive: window ka size badle to layout bhi theek ho jaye.
